CPU_source_selection: lexicographically first two DEV document IDs; no output-based document selection

sign_tolerance.scale: max absolute G/N/C across R0/R1 for this tensor
sign_tolerance.scope: New P5 sign-classification tolerance frozen before derived P5 tables; original P4 exact-sign increase flag is also retained

candidate_pool.actual_order: seeded distinct flat coordinates per lexicographic document; finite nonzero, deduplicate axis/bit retaining first
candidate_pool.challenge: first up to512 rows with at least one finite A/B differing output, first differing output index, no GPU output used

single_term.controls: POWER1/POWER_EIGHTH each512 selected axes, not all input axes

sparse.mask_seed_mapping: SeedSequence[61027027,layer,document_index,512,1024],512 permutations; same prefix of each row permutation for every K
sparse.rounding_uncertainty: FP64 absolute-dot error bound; exact dyadic subset resolves selected cells only

B_stopping_rules.B: D1 versus exact A unexplained => IMPLEMENTATION_UNRESOLVED
B_stopping_rules.C: Stable actual DEV coefficient one-term difference => C NOT_RUN_NOT_NEEDED
B_stopping_rules.D: Actual coefficient one-term equal,3 blocks stable => conditional C
B_stopping_rules.E: Unstable or resource failure => partial, no automatic expansion
